notes.title: Giant Bear Rampage! V1.06 UPDATE! 🐻
notes.content:
Firstly, A BIG THANK YOU to anyone taking the time to read this! 

After releasing the Anniversary Update (v1.05) I have been listening to your feedback, reviews and adding to the game in order to make it better than ever.

Since the 3-Year Anniversary, I have continued building and improving🐻
@GameDevMikey is my twitter handle if you want to get in touch.

☢️ New Radar Ability! 🐻
Use the Radar ability to find collectable mutation points and unlock powers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/607c7514662acd2989c2adda75083ce3267b96d7.gif

☢️ Create New Bear Menu! 🐻
New Players can customise their starting bear and super powers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/462169e5dd649c1405cfbe84ea635a4f4a303442.gif

🐻 A List of Improvements ☢️

- Added New "Radar" Ability (Default Key "R", Used to Find Mutation Points in the World).
- Mutation Points Ping their Location to Bear.
- New Game Bear Menu, Customisation and Starting Power Select.
- Reset Warning for New Bear Added.
- Font Style on Settings Page Updated to Match Game Style.
- Adjusted Super Power Unlock Cost.
- Lowered the cost of casting super powers.
- Added Key-Bind Settings for Radar Ability.
- Updated Mutation Point Tutorial and Game Intro Tutorial.


💻Thanks to the YouTubers and Streamers too...😎
Your help in sharing my game is appreciated more than you think, it helps people discover the projects I put a ton of time, effort and love into. Here is a png version of the Giant Bear Rampage logo, So that you can use it in your thumbnails.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/34503731b2c25ea95e83a5090d22e1b720bfdeaa.png

Thank you for checking out my game! 😎👍

If you don't know my name is Mikey and I'm a one-man indie developer, surprisingly I had developed the original release of the game on a laptop that was old and was barely over 720p in resolution, since then I have managed to update my hardware and work on it again.

notes.title: Giant Bear Rampage - Halloween Update V1.04
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/57182e305457b75e56ca723275505c4d63ac557f.jpg

Halloween Update V1.04 is Now Live!

The Update Includes a new Cheat Code system and an optional Blood Mode.

The option is available on the Main Menu on the Level Select Screen. It will be further expanded upon in future updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/81628fa70f2cbf60a7ac9e4d38b011d73cd56506.png

To Access the Cheat Code Menu, Press the "K" key on the Pause Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/2f4b172572f82c07394dec518d35d33dcb1d6079.jpg

The Cheat code system will added to in upcoming and future updates. :)

Usable Cheat Codes.

UnlimitedPower - Gives you Very fast regenerating energy! Spam super powers etc... 

Bulletproof - Gives you Very fast regenerating health!

HypedUp - Normal speed is equivalent to sprinting!

SpringLoaded - Double's your jump height!

Bloating - Double your size.

Thinn - Half your size.

ResetBear - Return to normal bear size.

Please give your suggestions for other cheat codes I could add! 🐻

notes.title: Version 1.01 is Now Up and Ready to Go! New Content and Features!
notes.content:

New Features!

Other Updates and Improvements!

If you have any features you'd like to see added, let me know.

More content is coming!
Thanks everyone!
-Mikey
